result.stdout:
dnrelay-tool tool-refresh
Bump or set tool version, pack the local tool, and update or install it in the local tool manifest.

Usage:
  dnrelay-tool tool-refresh [project] [--configuration <Debug|Release>] [--bump <patch|minor|major>] [--version <semver>]

Arguments:
  [project]      Tool project path. Defaults to the single PackAsTool project in the repo

Options:
  --configuration  dotnet pack configuration. Default is Release
  --bump           Version part to increment. Default comes from <ToolRefreshBump> or patch
  --version        Set an explicit target version instead of bumping

Notes:
  Prefer running this as the installed local tool: dotnet dnrelay-tool tool-refresh
  Running tool-refresh through dotnet run can self-lock the apphost during pack.
  If the tool is not yet installed in the local manifest, tool-refresh installs it after packing.
